t: Pete Buttigieg: Paving Roads Through Human Noise
d: Pete Buttigieg and Eugene Khoza join Trevor to discuss public service, political communication, infrastructure, generational leadership and the challenge of making government feel human.

t: Jonathan Haidt: Childhood After the Phone Ate It
d: Jonathan Haidt and Christiana Mbakwe Medina join Trevor to examine phone-based childhoods, anxious families, and the collapse of unsupervised play.

t: Ta-Nehisi Coates: Opening the Black Box
d: Author Ta-Nehisi Coates links up with Trevor and Christiana to analyze black media complexity, systemic creative boundaries, and true human visibility.

t: John Oliver: Making Outrage Pay Rent
d: John Oliver and Eugene Khoza join Trevor for a sharp conversation about political comedy, public outrage, media pressure and the strange responsibility of making serious issues funny.

t: Josh Johnson: Running From Silence Into Punchlines
d: Comedian Josh Johnson joins Trevor and Eugene Khoza to swap perspectives on high-stakes performance grinds, athletic isolation, and life logic loops.
